name.meaning: She that is to be examined

summary_for_children: Al-Mumtahanah means She Who Is Examined. It points to Ibrahim as an example and teaches being just and kind to people who are not hostile.
environment_concept: A bridge over a stream for fair dealings (60:8) and a garden of hope (60:7).
architecture_and_scenery: Two villages separated by a river, bridges rebuilt for fair dealing.

areas.name: Hope of Affection
areas.description: A garden where enemies may become friends.

activities.name: Fair trade
activities.description: Carry three baskets across, dealing fairly.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (bridge, orchard) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: Two small villages facing each other across a stream, posts standing in the water and plank piles on both banks

primary_mechanic.text: Lay a plank across each gap between posts (gaps 2.6-4.0 m) from planks sent by both villages; a plank must rest 0.2 m on each post, too-short ones are refused, and using a long plank on a narrow gap leaves the widest gap without one (lift planks back to fix it). Each laid plank becomes walkable (60:7-8).

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on your bank, the bridge, then a reading in the far village
environment_behaviour: each plank appears and can be walked on as it is laid
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that Allah loves those who are just and kind to neighbours who do no harm (60:8)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Kindness and Fairness
story_library.children_narration: Surah Al-Mumtahanah teaches important lessons about loyalty, faith, fairness, and relationships between communities. It reminds believers that they may treat people who are not fighting them with kindness and justice.

world_idea.title: The Bridge Between Communities
world_idea.description: Help two fictional communities exchange supplies, resolve misunderstandings, and build respectful relationships. The gameplay illustrates ethical principles rather than reconstructing the surah's historical incidents. ## Part 4 — Surahs 61–80

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
